title: ClockConfig
description:
Sequence alignment input shared by all commands that accept an alignment.

Each `--alignment` file is one partition, numbered by its position in the list (1, 2, ...). The path `-` reads
uncompressed FASTA from standard input and may appear at most once.

alignment.description:
Aligned FASTA input, plain or compressed (`gz`, `bz2`, `xz`, `zst`); compression is detected by extension.

Each `--alignment` file is one partition, numbered by its position in the list (1, 2, ...). Use `-` to read
uncompressed FASTA from standard input; `-` may appear at most once.

tree_dialect.description:
Newick dialect of the tree inputs (the tree and the reference topology)

A dialect is a tree structure and an annotation convention, written as <structure>,<annotations>. The structure
is classic (plain labels and branch lengths), enewick (hybrid nodes such as x#H1) or rich (eNewick with support
and probability fields). The annotations are plain (comments are text), beast ([&key=value]), nhx
([&&NHX:key=value]) or mrbayes ([&B name value]). For example, enewick,beast reads networks with BEAST annotations
and classic,nhx reads NHX trees. TreeTime reads trees only, so a network input is an error.

vcf_reference.description: Only for vcf input: fasta file of the sequence the VCF was mapped to.

metadata.description:
Metadata table (CSV or TSV) with one row per sample

`--metadata-id-columns` names the column that links a row to a tree tip. The other columns hold the data of the
sample, such as its sampling date or its traits.

metadata_id_columns.description:
Candidate column name(s) holding the taxon identifier that links metadata to tree tips

The first listed column that is present in the header is used. Matching is case-insensitive.

metadata_delimiters.description:
Candidate field delimiter(s) for the metadata table

The delimiter actually present in the file is used. Defaults to comma, tab, and semicolon.

date_column.description: Label of the column to be used as sampling date (auto-detected when omitted)

date_format.description: Format used to parse string sampling dates (numeric, ISO, and uncertain dates parse regardless)

model.description:
Substitution model to use

`infer` infers a model from the data of each partition; each `--alignment` file is one partition. Alternatively,
name the model type. If the named model takes parameters, use `--model-params` to set them.

model_params.description:
Parameters for the model selected by `--model`, given as space-separated `key=value` items

The parameters apply to the model of every partition; each `--alignment` file is one partition. Example: `--model
k80 --model-params kappa=0.2 pis=0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25`.

branch_length_mode.description: If set to 'input', the provided branch length will be used without modification. Branch lengths optimized by treetime are only accurate at short evolutionary distances.

method_anc.description: Method used for reconstructing ancestral sequences, which places the mutations on the branches

clock_filter.description:
Ignore tips that do not follow a loose clock: the number of interquartile ranges from the root-to-tip regression
beyond which a tip is an outlier.

0 switches the filter off.

allow_negative_rate.description:
Allow negative clock rates.

By default, rates are forced to be positive. For trees with little temporal signal, removing this restriction
gives essentially mid-point rooting.

reroot.description:
Reroot the tree by temporal-signal optimization.

Defaults to least-squares when rerooting is enabled. Use --keep-root to keep the input root.

reroot_tips.description: Reroot on the branch leading to a tip, or to the most recent common ancestor of several tips.

keep_root.description: Keep the root of the input tree instead of rerooting it.

output_all.description:
Write all default output files into this directory.

Produces the default set of tree and non-tree outputs for the command, using
`<dir>/<command>.<ext>` paths. Combine with `--output-selection` to restrict which
outputs are written.

Per-file flags (`--output-tree-nwk`, `--output-augur-node-data`, etc.) override or
supplement the files produced by `--output-all`.

An output that the run has no data for is skipped without a message, for example the
substitution model of a run that fits none. A per-file flag for such an output fails.

With several `--alignment` files, the outputs that carry sequence positions are written
once per file: reconstructed sequences, the augur node data of `ancestral`, Auspice, UShER
MAT, and Newick and Nexus trees in an annotated style. Files are numbered 1, 2, ... in the
order of the `--alignment` list. Their default names carry the number after the command
name (`<dir>/<command>.1.<ext>`), and the file name of a per-file flag for such an output
must contain `{partition}`, which is replaced by the number. Other tree outputs with
`{partition}` in their file name are also written once per file.

An output path that ends in `.gz`, `.bz2`, `.xz`, or `.zst` writes a compressed file. The
compression level is 2, unless the environment variable `GZ_COMPRESSION`, `BZ2_COMPRESSION`,
`XZ_COMPRESSION`, or `ZST_COMPRESSION` sets another level. `.gz`, `.xz`, and `.zst` compress
with all `--jobs` threads. `.bz2` compresses with one thread and is much slower to write and
to read than the other formats.

output_nwk_style.description:
NWK/Nexus annotation styles to write: `plain`, `beast`, `nhx`.

Applies to every NWK and Nexus output. With more than one style, files are distinguished by a
secondary extension (`.annotated` for beast, `.nhx` for nhx). Default: `plain`.

output_tree_nwk.description:
Path to output Newick tree file.

Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`. With
multiple `--output-nwk-style` values, a secondary extension is inserted per style.

With several `--alignment` files, the styles other than `plain` write one file per
alignment, and the file name must contain `{partition}`, which is replaced by the number
of the alignment (1, 2, ...).

Compression: path ending in `.gz`, `.bz2`, `.xz`, `.zst` writes compressed output.
Use `-` to write uncompressed to stdout.

Parent directories are created if missing.

output_clock_model.description:
Path to output clock model JSON.

Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

output_clock_csv.description:
Path to output clock regression CSV.

One row per sample: the date the regression used, the root-to-tip distance it regressed on, the date the clock
model predicts from that distance, and whether the clock filter excluded the sample. Takes precedence over paths
configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

output_clock_chart_svg.description:
Path to output root-to-tip regression chart in SVG format.

Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

output_clock_chart_png.description:
Path to output root-to-tip regression chart in PNG format.

Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

output_clock_chart_pdf.description:
Path to output root-to-tip regression chart in PDF format.

Takes precedence over paths configured with `--output-all` and `--output-selection`.

output_selection.description:
List of outputs to produce with `--output-all`.

Restricts which outputs `--output-all` writes. Special value `all` expands to every output available for this
command. Requires `--output-all`. Per-file flags are always honored regardless of this selection.

A selected output that the run has no data for is skipped without a message, for example the substitution
model of a run that fits none. A per-file flag for such an output fails.

ladderize.description: Order tree topology before writing output files.

topology_order_target_file.description: File used by list or reference-topology target-order sources.

topology_order_target_aggregate.description: Aggregate used to map a subtree to a target-order position.

clock_filter_method.description: Method for clock filter outlier detection (not yet implemented)

plot_rtt.description: Filename to save root-to-tip regression plot (not yet implemented)

prune_outliers.description: Prune clock outlier tips from the tree (not yet implemented)

$schema.description: Path or URL of the JSON schema for this config; used by editors and ignored by the loader.

oneOf.description: Infer GTR parameters from data via Fitch parsimony substitution counts.
